All 5 facts confirmed on MLIT Edogawa River Office pages: 22 m tank depth, 59 pillars, 18 m pillar height (edogawa_hant00728, also 177x78x18 m tank); shafts about 70 m deep, 30 m wide (edogawa00404; Pacific Consultants URL now 301-redirects); channel 50 m below ground (MLIT English overview edogawa_index045, plus Wikipedia citing Water Technology). Verify list followed: MLIT 18 m used over Wikipedia's 25.4 m, 'about 70 m' said, 'outside Tokyo' said. No advice, no hedging problems; description ends with the channel disclaimer. Style note: the last line 'the field stays dry' is loose, since the channel protects the surrounding river basin rather than that field.
